claims.claim_text: The F-35 program generated 27% of Lockheed Martin's total consolidated sales in 2025, and 67% of Aeronautics sales in 2025.
claims.subject: F-35 Lightning II
claims.object_value: 27% of 2025 total consolidated sales (67% of Aeronautics)
claims.source_quote: The F-35 program is our largest program, generating 27% of our total consolidated sales, as well as 67% of Aeronautics sales in 2025.

claims.claim_text: Aircraft production is expected to continue well into the future given the U.S. Government's stated objective of procuring 2,456 F-35 aircraft for the U.S. Air Force, U.S. Marine Corps, and U.S. Navy.
claims.subject: F-35 program of record
claims.source_quote: Aircraft production is expected to continue well into the future given the U.S. Government s stated objective of procuring 2,456 aircraft for the U.S. Air Force, U.S. Marine Corps, and U.S. Navy.

claims.claim_text: The Next Generation Interceptor (NGI) is a program with the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) for homeland missile defense in which Lockheed Martin participates as a Space-segment program.
claims.subject: Next Generation Interceptor (NGI)
claims.source_quote: Next Generation Interceptor (NGI), a program with the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) utilizing next generation propulsion and sensors to provide homeland missile defense.

claims.claim_text: Next Generation Overhead Persistent Infrared (Next Gen OPIR) provides the U.S. Space Force with enhanced worldwide missile warning capabilities and is a named Space-segment program.
claims.subject: Next Gen OPIR
claims.object_value: Space Force missile warning satellite program
claims.source_quote: The Next Generation Overhead Persistent Infrared (Next Gen OPIR) system, which provides the U.S. Space Force with enhanced worldwide missile warning capabilities.

claims.claim_text: The Transport and Tracking Layer programs comprise multiple tranches of small satellites supporting the Space Development Agency proliferated space architecture, with constellations of missile warning and communications satellites.
claims.subject: SDA Transport and Tracking Layer (multi-tranche)
claims.object_value: SDA proliferated warfighter space architecture multi-tranche
claims.source_quote: The Transport and Tracking Layer programs, multiple tranches of small satellites to support the proliferated space architecture, with constellations of missile warning and communications satellites for the Space Development Agency.

claims.claim_text: Lockheed Martin produces the Long Range Discrimination Radar (LRDR) for the Missile Defense Agency.
claims.subject: Long Range Discrimination Radar (LRDR)
claims.object_value: MDA radar production line (cohort meta: PE 0604873C)
claims.source_quote: Largest US defense prime. F-35 prime, F-22A sustainment, AEGIS BMD, Next-Gen OPIR-GEO, LRDR, NGI competition.

claims.claim_text: Aegis Combat System programs serve as an air and missile defense system for the U.S. Navy and international customers and are a sea/land-based element of the U.S. missile defense system. (Aegis BMD Test is named for Lockheed in the J-Book corpus.)
claims.subject: Aegis Combat System / Aegis BMD
claims.source_quote: Aegis Combat System (Aegis) programs that serve as an air and missile defense system for the U.S. Navy and international customers and are also a sea and land-based element of the U.S. missile defense system

claims.claim_text: The Trident II D5 Fleet Ballistic Missile is the only submarine-launched intercontinental ballistic missile currently in production in the U.S., on contract with the U.S. Navy.
claims.subject: Trident II D5 FBM
claims.source_quote: The Trident II D5 Fleet Ballistic Missile (FBM), a program with the U.S. Navy for the only submarine-launched intercontinental ballistic missile currently in production in the U.S.

claims.claim_text: In 2025, 28% of total sales were associated with international customers (FMS and DCS).
claims.subject: International revenue
claims.source_quote: In 2025, 28% of our total sales were associated with international customers.

claims.claim_text: In Q2 2025 Lockheed Martin paid $360 million to acquire Amentum's Rapid Solutions business to enhance Space-segment radar and payload capabilities; recorded $195 million goodwill in Space.
claims.subject: Acquisition of Rapid Solutions (from Amentum)
claims.source_quote: During the second quarter of 2025, we paid $ 360 million, in cash, for the acquisition of Amentum s Rapid Solutions business (Rapid Solutions). The acquisition of Rapid Solutions is expected to enhance our Space business segment s capabilities, particularly in radar and payload technology

args.rationale: radar and payload technology for Space domain awareness

claims.claim_text: Lockheed Martin owns or leases building space at 333 locations primarily in the U.S., with significant Aeronautics presence in Palmdale CA, Marietta GA, Greenville SC, and Fort Worth TX; MFC in Troy AL, Camden AR, Ocala/Orlando FL, Lexington KY, Grand Prairie TX.
claims.subject: Facility footprint
claims.object_value: 333 locations; 66.5M total sqft (35.4M owned + 14.1M leased + 17.0M govt-owned)
claims.source_quote: At December 31, 2025, we owned or leased building space (including offices, manufacturing plants, warehouses, service centers, laboratories and other facilities) at 333 locations primarily in the U.S.
